Gold / Silver: Two youngsters' Pokémon are shown battling on Route 30; the scene occupies the route before the Mystery Egg quest is completed.
Crystal: Same core blocking/battle spectacle, with the same Joey/Mikey setup and visible Pokémon actors.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Keeps the staged battle idea but uses explicit Rattata/Pidgey Pokémon objects and scripted animation in `R30`.
Integration decision: Preserve the GSC route gate and event timing. Treat HGSS as a presentation variant: retain the existing visible-Pokémon battle staging
Class: optionally adopting HGSS's Rattata/Pidgey pairing and choreography instead of GSC's Rattata/Rattata pairing; do not change when the path opens.

Event: Mr. Pokémon gives the Mystery Egg
Gold / Silver: Mr. Pokémon receives the player, gives the Mystery Egg, explains the Day-Care origin, and turns the conversation over to Oak.
Crystal: Same core scene and story fact.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Same story fact with longer movement choreography, follower handling, healing transition, and scene-variable updates.
Integration decision: Keep the GSC Mystery Egg flag and item handoff authoritative. Backport HGSS movement/healing choreography around the same completion state.

Gold / Silver: Oak evaluates the player, gives the Pokédex, then leaves for Goldenrod.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Same sequence, plus registers Professor Oak as a Pokégear phone contact before leaving.
Integration decision: Preserve the GSC Pokédex acquisition and Oak departure. Add Oak's phone registration as an HGSS extension if the expanded phonebook is enabled.

Event: Elm panic call after Mr. Pokémon's house
Gold / Silver: The robbery call is armed by the Mr. Pokémon house sequence and triggers the return to New Bark.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: `R30` explicitly sets the Elm panic-call flag, places the phone call, and advances the Route 30 scene variable.
Integration decision: Keep the original GSC robbery-call story flag as canonical; adopt HGSS's explicit call-state bookkeeping to prevent duplicate or missed calls.

Gold / Silver: Optional tutorial by the tutorial man; player may decline. Demonstrates catching a Lv. 5 Rattata and can be repeated later.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Replaced by the opposite-gender friend and Marill. The main scene proceeds directly into the tutorial and then gives 5 Poké Balls.
Integration decision: Preserve GSC player choice. If accepted, use the HGSS friend + Marill staging. Use one shared starter-ball receipt flag so rewards do not duplicate.

Gold / Silver: Elm's aide supplies 5 Poké Balls after the Mystery Egg is returned.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: The Route 29 friend gives 5 Poké Balls immediately after the catching demonstration.
Integration decision: Keep both scenes but only one actual reward. Whichever scene runs first sets the shared receipt flag; the later scene changes to acknowledgement/tutorial dialogue.

Event: HGSS Apricorn Box scene on Route 30
Gold / Silver: No Apricorn Box key-item scene; Gen II handles the relevant field/item structure differently.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: A dedicated Route 30 Apricorn man scene gives the Apricorn Box and sets `FLAG_GOT_APRICORN_BOX`.
Integration decision: Backport only when the Gen IV-style Apricorn inventory/UI layer is implemented. Never gate main-story progression on this new key item.

Gold / Silver: Earl and the Trainer School remain an early-city tutorial element.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Retains the school-guide concept with expanded pathing/escort scripting in Violet City.
Integration decision: Keep the GSC Earl event and backport only expanded movement/escort presentation.

Event: Sprout Tower vs. Violet Gym ordering
Gold / Silver: Sprout Tower and Falkner are loosely coupled; the Elder's Flash reward references the badge for field use, without HGSS's explicit before/after guide-state swap.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Defeating Elder Li flips the Violet Gym guide from a pre-Sprout object state to a post-Sprout state, making the tower an explicit early progression beat.
Integration decision: Do not delete GSC freedom. Let the Gym be entered early and use the HGSS guide as a soft gate/recommendation; branch follow-up dialogue if Falkner was beaten first.

Gold / Silver: Rival has already beaten the Elder; Elder criticizes his harsh treatment of Pokémon. Rival dismisses the lecture and escapes.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Preserves the same confrontation and dialogue role, with expanded movement/disappearance animation and dedicated state flags.
Integration decision: Treat the GSC scene as canonical. Backport HGSS choreography and safer completion flags without rewriting rival characterization.

Gold / Silver: Elder gives HM05 Flash after battle.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Elder gives TM70 Flash, then flips Violet Gym guide state flags.
Integration decision: For the GSC engine, keep HM05 as the canonical story reward. Record TM70 as the Gen IV counterpart and expose it only after expanded TM/HM architecture exists.

Gold / Silver: Falkner awards Zephyr Badge and TM31 Mud-Slap; the badge sequence initiates Elm's assistant call.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Same badge progression, but reward is TM51 Roost; winning sets Violet/Elm scene state for the Togepi Egg handoff.
Integration decision: Keep badge and Elm-call progression identical. Preserve TM31 and add TM51 only as an explicitly documented project integration reward after TM expansion.

Gold / Silver: Elm's aide delivers the Togepi Egg in Violet's Pokémon Center after the first badge.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Elm calls after the badge, makes the aide appear in Violet Poké Mart, and the aide gives the Togepi Egg there.
Integration decision: Support both source locations with one shared `TOGEPI_EGG_CLAIMED` flag. First valid interaction gives the egg; the other becomes follow-up dialogue.

Event: First Kimono Girl story encounter in Violet
Gold / Silver: No equivalent main-story Kimono Girl event tied to the Togepi Egg.
Crystal: No equivalent HGSS-style five-Kimono-Girl story chain here.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: After the Poké Mart aide gives the Togepi Egg, Violet City scene state advances and exposes a Kimono Girl event on return to the overworld.
Integration decision: Add as the first HGSS Kimono Girl chain flag, triggered by shared Togepi Egg acquisition regardless of which aide location was used.
